title: GovernanceKernelInput
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining the canonical input envelope for the Governance Kernel, including actor, context, doctrine, predictive signals, wellbeing constraints, and target information.

inputId.description: Unique identifier for this governance kernel input envelope.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the input was generated.

actorContext.description: Information about the actor initiating the governance action.

decisionContext.description: Operational decision context including purpose, scope, and parameters.

environmentContext.description: Environmental and situational context relevant to the decision.

policyContext.description: Policy definition or policy set relevant to the decision.

doctrine.description: Compiled doctrinal rules and validation results.
